claim_one_line: THE WEB SEAT'S CARD ON THE GOLDEN STATE, VERIFIED ON MAIN CELL BY CELL (a weave object, conditional on stated choices; data-free; 30 digits, and 18 for the grid and the three checks made on it, A4, A5 and H5 [added 2026-11-12, Review 79's second round; CORRECTED the same day at Review 80: this read "the two checks"]; 31 checks [32 before 2026-11-12: one was a check over an empty list and is no longer counted; Review 79], of which the one that fails is main's own guess at how closely the agy lane's point would agree): Maass's form of the golden field at level 5, rebuilt from its definition, transforms with the quadratic character to 2.3e-30, is odd under the mirror and changes sign under the dual involution, and vanishes at both elliptic points, at both points of discriminant -20 and along the second stretch of the arc; on the first stretch its density against the hyperbolic area has exactly one maximum, a strict maximum in the plane (gradient 2.7e-30 of the peak, curvatures -82.86 and -76.66 of the peak, summing to -2(1/4 + R^2)/y^2 as an eigenfunction's must), at the web seat's point to every digit main prints, with nothing greater on a grid of the strip. MAIN ADDS: in the cell bounded by the mirror's two lines and the two circles the state vanishes on three sides and has zero normal derivative on the fourth, where the greatest place lies; it has one sign on 14,432 grid points of the cell, which if it has no zero there makes it the lowest state of its own symmetry class and says nothing of the other three classes; at level 5 the state vanishes at every point with a symmetry of its own, and at 13 and 17 it does not (zero at 13's points of order 2, 1.4 of the scale at its points of order 3, 1.36 at 17's points of order 2); against the chart's Euclidean area the greatest place lies 0.057 away, off the circle, so the place depends on the measure. [CORRECTED 2026-11-12 (Review 79): 0.056 away; 0.057 was the nearest point of main's grid. And what this line calls the greatest place being one pair is found on a grid and not proved, as the findings say.] THE AGY LANE'S REPORTED POINT is 1.5e-9 from the greatest place and is not it: the gradient there is 1.24e-7 of the peak and the point is 1.33e-9 off the circle. Two of main's own checks failed at the first run by main's fault, a series cut too short at levels 13 and 17, and are mended with a guard; six checks were added after the first run and say so. Not shown: that the state is the lowest of its sector, or simple. It selects nothing and derives no value: level, mark, surface, sector, state, clock, measure and frame are choices that stand; it is a check of seats' work and not main's design for the read-out on the whole, of whose eight conditions it does not meet the sixth; and main, having now seen the lane's reported point, can no longer write that design blind to it. 0 of 19.
